paite: Huan, TOUPAN Mosi a houpiha,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

paite: Levi tate laka Kohath tate, a khangkhang un, a inkuankuan un, sim vek in,
english: “Take a census of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, by their families, by their fathers’ houses,

paite: Kum sawmthum akipan tunglam, kum sawmnga tanin nasepna na, kihoupihna puanin a sem ding teng.
english: from thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all who enter into the service, to do the work in the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Kihoupihna puanin mun siangthou pen Kohath tapate nasep ding hiai ahi:
english: “This is the service of the sons of Kohath in the Tent of Meeting, the most holy things.

paite: Ommun a suan ding teng un Aron a tapate toh a lut ding ua, mun siangthou puanjak a hawkkhe ding ua, huaiin thukun bawm a khuh ding uh;
english: When the camp moves forward, Aaron shall go in, and his sons, and they shall take down the veil of the screen, and cover the ark of the Testimony with it,

paite: Tuapen ngalvang vunin a khuh ding ua, huaipen puandum buangin a khuh ding ua, ajawnna chiang a thuah ding uh ahi.
english: and shall put a covering of sealskin on it, and shall spread over it a cloth all of blue, and shall put in its poles.

paite: Huan, etsakna tanghou dohkan tungah puandum buang a phah ding ua, huailaiah kuangte, keute, belhbute leh noute a but khiakna ding a koih ding uh ahi; huan, tatkakloua tanghou koih huailaiah a om ding ahi:
english: “On the table of show bread they shall spread a blue cloth, and put on it the dishes, the spoons, the bowls, and the cups with which to pour out; and the continual bread shall be on it.

paite: Tuapen puan sanin a khuh ding ua; a khuhna ngalvang vunin a khuh ding uh, a jawnna chiang a thuah ding uhi.
english: They shall spread on them a scarlet cloth, and cover the same with a covering of sealskin, and shall put in its poles.

paite: Huan, vaksak khawnvak koihna leh huai adinga a zat ding ua khawnvakte, a taitehte, a vu koihnate, thau bing tengteng puandum buangin a khuh ding uhi:
english: “They shall take a blue cloth, and cover the lampstand of the light, and its lamps, and its snuffers, and its snuff dishes, and all its oil vessels, with which they minister to it.

paite: Huai leh a vanzat tengteng a khuhna ngalvang vuna khuhin a jawnna ah a koih ding uh ahi.
english: They shall put it and all its vessels within a covering of sealskin, and shall put it on the frame.

paite: Huan, dangkaeng maitam puandum buangin a khuh ding ua, a khuhna ngalvang vunin a khuh nawn ding uh, a jawnna chiang a thuah ding uhi:
english: “On the golden altar they shall spread a blue cloth, and cover it with a covering of sealskin, and shall put in its poles.

paite: Mun siangthou, huailaia a vanzat uh, tuiumbelsuan tengteng a la vek ding ua, puandum buangin a tun ding ua, a khuhna ngalvang vunin a khuh ding uh, a jawnnna ah a koih uhi.
english: “They shall take all the vessels of ministry, with which they minister in the sanctuary, and put them in a blue cloth, and cover them with a covering of sealskin, and shall put them on the frame.

paite: Huan, maitama meivu a la mang ding ua, a tungah puan sandup a phah ding uh:
english: “They shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth on it.

paite: Huan, a tungah a na sep vialvialna uh tuiumbelsuan tengteng, mei lakna te, sa thukna sikkhut te vutluahna te, tuikuang te, maitam tuiumbelsuan tengteng te a koih ding uhi; huan, a khuhna ngalvang vunin a khuh ding uh, a jawnna a bulh ding uh.
english: They shall put on it all its vessels, with which they minister about it, the fire pans, the flesh hooks, the shovels, and the basins; all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread on it a covering of sealskin, and put in its poles.

paite: Huan, Aron leh a tapaten mun siangthou leh mun siangthou van tengteng ommun suan dinga akhuh khit chiang un; huai khit chiangin a jawng dingin Kohath tapate a hongpai ding uhi: ahihhangin thil siangthou himhim a khoih ding uh ahi kei, huchilouin jaw a si kha ding uhi. Hiaite kihoupihna puanina Kohath tapate nasep ding ahi.
english: “When Aaron and his sons have finished covering the sanctuary, and all the furniture of the sanctuary, as the camp moves forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to carry it: but they shall not touch the sanctuary, lest they die. These things are the burden of the sons of Kohath in the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Huan, siampu Aron tapa Eleazar sep ding, det ding thau te, namtui te, tatlak loua tangbuang thillatte, sathau nilh chite, biakbuk, huailaia thil om tentengte, mun siangthou leh a vante ngaihtuah khawng ahi, chiin.
english: “The duty of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be the oil for the light, the sweet incense, the continual meal offering, and the anointing oil, the requirements of all the tabernacle, and of all that is in it, the sanctuary, and its furnishings.”

paite: Huan, TOUPAN Mosi leh Aron a houpiha,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

paite: Kohath suan inkuan jaw Levite lak akipan mang mai loua:
english: “Don’t cut off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites;

paite: Thil siangthoute khoih loua si loua a om theihna ding uh hichibangin hihih: Aron leh a tapate lut uhenla, a sep ding uh leh a tantuam ding chiat uh seh sakin:
english: but thus do to them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach to the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in, and appoint them everyone to his service and to his burden;

paite: Ahihhangin thil siangthou en dingin sawt lou chik leng lut kei uhen, a lut uleh a si ding uh, chiin,
english: but they shall not go in to see the sanctuary even for a moment, lest they die.”

paite: Huan, TOUPAN Mosi a houpiha,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: Gerson tapate leng a inkuankuan un, a khangkhang un sim vekin;
english: “Take a census of the sons of Gershon also, by their fathers’ houses, by their families;

paite: Kum sawmthum akipan a tunglam kum sawmngaa upa tanin nasepna na kihoupihna puanina sem thei ding teng zah sim vekin.
english: you shall count them from thirty years old and upward until fifty years old; all who enter in to wait on the service, to do the work in the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Gerson suante tantuam naseplam leh puaklam ahi:
english: “This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, in serving and in bearing burdens:

paite: Biakbuk puanjakte, kihoupihna puanin te, a khuhna te, a tung khuhna ngalvang vunte, kihoupihna puanin kongkhak puanjakte;
english: they shall carry the curtains of the tabernacle, and the Tent of Meeting, its covering, and the covering of sealskin that is above on it, and the screen for the door of the Tent of Meeting,

paite: Intual puanjak te, intual kongkhak puanjak te, abiakbuk leh maitam bula, akhaute, a vanzat tengteng uh toh a po ding ua, hih dia kiphamoh peuhmah a hih ding uh ahi.
english: and the hangings of the court, and the screen for the door of the gate of the court, which is by the tabernacle and around the altar, and their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and whatever shall be done with them. Therein shall they serve.

paite: Gerson suante nasep a naseplam uleh puaklam ah a tantuam tengteng uh Aron leh a tapate ahi ding; ahih ding uh banghiam nengneng tana sehsak dingin thu na neisak ding.
english: At the commandment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burden, and in all their service; and you shall appoint their duty to them in all their responsibilities.

paite: Huaite kihoupihna puanina Gerson suante nasep ahi: a hihding uh siampu Aron tapa Ithamar seh ding ahi.
english: This is the service of the families of the sons of the Gershonites in the Tent of Meeting: and their duty shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

paite: Merari tapate, akhangkhang un, a inkuankuan un na sim ding ahi;
english: “As for the sons of Merari, you shall number them by their families, by their fathers’ houses;

paite: Kum sawmthum akipan tunglam kum sawmngaa upa tanin kihoupihna puanina sem ding zah na sim vek ding hi.
english: you shall count them from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone who enters on the service, to do the work of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Kihoupihna puanina a nasep uh, a tantuan ding uh hiai ahi-biakbuk khuam lepkhawm te, a bangkal te, akhuam te, a kingakna khuakhuakte;
english: This is the duty of their burden, according to all their service in the Tent of Meeting: the tabernacle’s boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets,

paite: A intual umna khuamte, akingakna khuakkhuakte, a kilhbelhnate, a khau te, a vanzat tengteng leh a vanzat dang tengteng puak te: a min uh lou jel chiatin a tantuam ding uh na sehsak ding ahi.
english: and the pillars of the court around it, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords, with all their instruments, and with all their service: and by name you shall appoint the instruments of the duty of their burden.

paite: Huaite amau siampu Aron tapa Ithamar heua khoupihna puanina Merari tapate suanten a hihding uh banghiam nengneng tana a nasep dan ding uh, chiin.
english: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service, in the Tent of Meeting, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.”

paite: Huchiin Mosi leh Aron leh khawmpi laka lupenten Kohathte tapate a khangkhang un, a inkuankuan un a simta ua,
english: Moses and Aaron and the princes of the congregation numbered the sons of the Kohathites by their families, and by their fathers’ houses,

paite: Kihoupihna puanina nasepnaa ding, mi chih nasem dia kisate, kum sawmthum akipan tunglam kum sawmngaa upa chiang:
english: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone who entered into the service, for work in the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Huaite a khangkhanga a sim uh sang nih leh za sagih leh sawmnga ahi uhi.
english: Those who were numbered of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred fifty.

paite: Hiaite ahi uh, kihoupihna puanina na sem jel Kohathte suan a simte uh Mosi zanga TOUPA thupiak banga Mosi leh Aronin a simte uh.
english: These are those who were numbered of the families of the Kohathites, all who served in the Tent of Meeting, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the commandment of Yahweh by Moses.

paite: Huan, hiaite a inkuankuana, a khangkhang ua kisim, Gerson tate ahi uh,
english: Those who were numbered of the sons of Gershon, their families, and by their fathers’ houses,

paite: Kum sawmthum akipan tunglam kum sawmngaa upa, kihoupihna puanin nasepna dinga, mi chih nasem jel dia kisate,
english: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone who entered into the service, for work in the Tent of Meeting,

paite: Huai a khangkhanga, a inkuankuan ua a simte uh sang nih leh za guk leh sawmthum ahi uh.
english: even those who were numbered of them, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, were two thousand six hundred thirty.

paite: Huaite ahi uh, Gerson tapate suante, kihoupihna puanina nasemte teng, TOUPA thupiak banga Mosi leh Aronin a simte uh.
english: These are those who were numbered of the families of the sons of Gershon, all who served in the Tent of Meeting, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the commandment of Yahweh.

paite: Huan, huaite a inkuankuan ua, a khangkhang ua, Merari tapa a simte uh ahi,
english: Those who were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, by their families, by their fathers’ houses,

paite: Kihoupihna puanin a sem dinga nasem zah ding, kum sawmthum akipan a tunglam kum sawmngaa upa chiang;
english: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone who entered into the service, for work in the Tent of Meeting,

paite: Huai a khangkhanga, a inkuankuana a simte uh sang thum leh za nih ahi uh,
english: even those who were numbered of them by their families, were three thousand two hundred.

paite: Huaite ahi uh, Merari tapate suante a sim uh, Mosi zanga TOUPA thupiak banga Mosi leh Aronin a simte uh.
english: These are those who were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the commandment of Yahweh by Moses.

paite: Mosi leh Aron leh Israelte lupenten a khangkhanga, a inkuankuana a simte uh avekun huaiteng ahi uh,
english: All those who were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron and the princes of Israel numbered, by their families, and by their fathers’ houses,

paite: Nasem ding leh kihoupihna puanina puak chi pomi ding zah, kum sawmthum akipan a tunglam kum sawmngaa upa chiang,
english: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone who entered in to do the work of service, and the work of bearing burdens in the Tent of Meeting,

paite: Huai a simte uh sang giat leh za nga leh sawmgiat ahi uh.Mosi zanga TOUPA thupiak banga mi chih a sepding uleh a tantuam ding uh dungjui jela a sim ahi: huchibang takin TOUPA Mosi thu a piak bang sim ahi uhi.
english: even those who were numbered of them, were eight thousand five hundred eighty.

paite: Mosi zanga TOUPA thupiak banga mi chih a sepding uleh a tantuam ding uh dungjui jela a sim ahi: huchibang takin TOUPA Mosi thu a piak bang sim ahi uhi.
english: According to the commandment of Yahweh they were numbered by Moses, everyone according to his service, and according to his burden. Thus were they numbered by him, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
